items.quote: How to convince the seller to lower the asking price? It's common sense, every seller thinks that his property is the best and costs the most.
items.statement: Instead of being pushy and logical, come from a different perspective when convincing a seller to lower their asking price.

items.quote: Let me ask you this. Who in your mind will be the person who will determine how much the property is actually worth?
items.statement: Asking questions and encouraging the seller to think about who determines the property's worth can lead to better engagement.

items.quote: ask him this question and wait till he will tell you it's a buyer.
items.statement: Engaging the seller in a question-based dialogue allows them to realize the importance of buyer perception in determining property value.

overview: A transcript of a YouTube short discussing strategies to convince property sellers to lower their asking prices.
